Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the rear-end collision you
were involved in in Pearland, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?
A: Yes, I understand.
Q: Please describe where you were and what you were doing when the collision happened.
A: I was stopped at a red light on a main road in Pearland, in the right-hand lane, waiting to turn. I had been sitting
there for maybe half a minute.
Q: What happened next?
A: I felt a hard jolt from behind. My head snapped forward and then back, and my car was pushed into the intersection
a few feet. The other driver was following too closely, I think.
Q: Did you speak with the other driver at the scene?
A: Briefly. He said he didn't see the light change in time and he was sorry. He seemed shaken up too.
Q: Were you taken to a medical facility?
A: An ambulance came, but I declined the ride. I drove myself to an urgent care clinic later that afternoon because my
right knee was swelling and I couldn't bend it properly.
Q: Can you describe the knee symptoms you have experienced since then?
A: It's sore when I walk, especially on stairs. It feels unstable at times, like it might give out. The swelling has gone
down a little, but I still limp by the end of the day.
Q: Have you received any treatemnt or referrals since the urgent care visit?
A: I was referred to an orthopedic specialist and I have a follow-up scheduled. They ordered an imaging study, and
I'm waiting on the results.
Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I want my car and my knee looked at properly. Thank you for listening.
Q: Thank you. That concludes this recorded statement.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page

- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

- "reason": one short sentence.
